cases.intent: Assigning a value cannot widen the authority declared for an existing binding.
repair_directions: Keep the existing binding read-only and do not write its payload.
Declare or obtain a source and destination whose payload authority matches the intended mutation.

cases.intent: Payload write permission does not imply permission to rebind the handle.
repair_directions: Keep the callee payload-only if it only mutates the payload.
Pass a declaration that explicitly grants handle rebinding when replacement is required.

cases.intent: A call-site H/P request cannot grant payload authority absent from the argument declaration.
repair_directions: Keep the callee handle-only if it does not write the payload.
Change the declaration or API contract before requesting payload write authority at the call.

cases.intent: A pattern binding inherits the borrowed Option view; adding # cannot turn a shared payload into a writable one.
repair_directions: Treat Option<&T> pattern payloads as read-only views.
Design the API around Option<&T#> when mutation through the matched borrow is required.
